stops.note: a chilled, sweet drink at the Ottoman court
adapted into a frozen dessert by Italian confectioners
from Turkish 'şerbet', a cooled fruit drink
the 1580s English sense was a cooling Eastern drink; after that passed to 'sherbet', English re-borrowed 'sorbet' in the 1800s for the frozen dessert

current_meaning: a frozen dessert made from sweetened fruit juice or puree
